title: Automotive hex bolt
description: a steel hex head bolt, item number 90017-RJA-0030, used as a high-strength automotive fastener
reference_excerpt: The product in question is a steel hex head bolt, specifically described as an indented hex flange head fastener with a fully threaded shaft, intended for use in automotive applications. The classification process began by considering the proposed HTS code 7318.15.2065; however, it was determined that the item does not meet the criteria for a bolt as it can be turned during assembly and does not necessarily require a nut for its intended function. Instead, it is classified as a screw based on the supplementary criteria of ASME B18.2.1.

classification.rationale: Heading 7318 names bolts of iron or steel, so GRI 1 decides the heading. H86188, an in-force ruling on a carbon-steel hex flange bolt for engines, classified it in 7318.15.80, the 6 mm or more line. The item's diameter is not given, so I assumed 6 mm or more. The suffix rests on that assumption and on the reading that .69 is the 'other' line for hex-head bolts. That reading is not confirmed, because the .45, .69 and .85 lines all use the label 'Other'.
